description: This file defines the SsoToken class in the Aws\Token namespace, representing tokens obtained from the AWS SSO provider, including properties related to token details and expiration logic.

classes.name: SsoToken
classes.description: Represents an SSO token from AWS SSO provider, with methods to access token details and check expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SsoToken with token details and properties.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token is expired based on current time and registration expiration or token expiration.

methods.name: getRefreshToken
methods.description: Returns the refresh token, if available.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getClientSecret
methods.description: Returns the client secret associated with the token.

methods.name: getStartUrl
methods.description: Returns the start URL for SSO.

methods.name: fromTokenData
methods.description: Creates an SsoToken instance from provided token data array.
